1 /**
2  * Wave 17 — High Seat fold + THE BADGE PATH BOUNDED — portfolio at a glance.
3  *
4  * Folds N typed projections (portfolio index + Wave-16 attention cells) into
5  * the raise queue and ⚑ badge. Answers criterion-13 fields from the EXISTING
6  * no-walk index — never a project-root walk. write_authority:'none' is

11  * the badge route. Ingest (attention push) updates the cached badge cell so
12  * each poll opens a bounded number of index-home files and at most one short-

156 /** Calls that would mutate the filesystem. */
157 export const GUARDED_WRITE_CALLS = Object.freeze([
158   'writeFileSync',
159   'writeFile',
160   'appendFileSync',
161   'appendFile',
162   'mkdirSync',
163   'mkdir',
164   'rmSync',
165   'rm',
166   'unlinkSync',
167   'unlink',
168   'renameSync',
169   'rename',
170   'copyFileSync',
171   'copyFile',
172   'openSync', // open for write is blocked via flag check in wrapper when possible

174   'truncateSync',
175   'rmdirSync',
176 ]);

178 export class WriteAuthorityRefusal extends Error {
179   /** @param {string} call @param {string} detail */
180   constructor(call, detail) {
181     super(`WRITE_AUTHORITY_NONE: ${call}() refused — ${detail}`);
182     this.name = 'WriteAuthorityRefusal';
183     this.code = 'WRITE_AUTHORITY_NONE';
184     this.call = call;
185     this.detail = detail;
186   }
187 }
188 
189 /**
190  * An fs facade that throws on any write-shaped call.
191  * Enforces write_authority:'none' (the string on the VM is a declaration only).
192  *
193  * @param {object|undefined} base
194  * @param {{ writes?: Array<object> }} [journal]
195  * @returns {object}
196  */
197 export function writeAuthorityNoneFs(base, journal = { writes: [] }) {
198   const facade = { ...(base ?? fs) };
199   for (const call of GUARDED_WRITE_CALLS) {
200     const original = facade[call];
201     facade[call] = (...args) => {
202       const entry = Object.freeze({ call, args0: args[0] != null ? String(args[0]) : null });
203       journal.writes.push(entry);
204       throw new WriteAuthorityRefusal(
205         call,
206         'High Seat fold has write_authority none; project trees must stay byte-identical',
207       );
208     };
209     // Keep typeof original for callers that probe; original unused by design.
210     void original;
211   }
212   return facade;
213 }
214 
215 /**
216  * Combined index-home-only read + write-authority-none trap.
217  * Reads outside home throw (query.mjs pattern); any write throws.
218  *
219  * @param {object|undefined} base
220  * @param {string} home
221  * @param {{reads: Array, outside: Array, total: number, writes: Array}} journal
222  * @returns {object}
223  */
224 export function glanceIndexOnlyFs(base, home, journal) {
225   if (!journal.writes) journal.writes = [];
226   const readGuarded = indexOnlyFs(base, home, journal);
227   return writeAuthorityNoneFs(readGuarded, journal);
228 }

230 /**
231  * Run `fn` under the write trap. Any write throws WriteAuthorityRefusal.
232  * @template T
233  * @param {() => T} fn
234  * @param {{ fsx?: object, journal?: object }} [opts]
235  * @returns {{ result: T, journal: object }}
236  */
237 export function withWriteAuthorityNone(fn, opts = {}) {
238   const journal = opts.journal ?? { writes: [] };
239   const trap = writeAuthorityNoneFs(opts.fsx ?? fs, journal);
240   // fn may close over trap via opts — also expose on a property for tests.
241   const result = fn({ fsx: trap, journal });
242   return { result, journal };
243 }

245 // ── Delimiter guard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

247 /**
248  * Partition roots that can cross the process boundary as a ';'-joined argv
249  * string. Roots containing the delimiter are SKIPPED for transport and must
250  * render as unknown rows (row count never shrinks).
251  *
252  * @param {string[]|string} roots
253  * @returns {Readonly<{ transportable: string[], skipped: string[], joined: string }>}
254  */
255 export function partitionRootsByDelimiter(roots = []) {
256   const list = Array.isArray(roots)
257     ? roots
258     : typeof roots === 'string'
259       ? roots.split(ROOT_DELIM).map((r) => r.trim()).filter(Boolean)
260       : [];
261   const transportable = [];
262   const skipped = [];
263   for (const r of list) {
264     const s = String(r ?? '').trim();
265     if (!s) continue;
266     if (s.includes(ROOT_DELIM)) skipped.push(s);
267     else transportable.push(s);
268   }
269   return Object.freeze({
270     transportable: Object.freeze([...transportable]),
271     skipped: Object.freeze([...skipped]),
272     joined: transportable.join(ROOT_DELIM),
273   });
274 }
275 
276 /**
277  * Round-trip: join transportable roots, split, assert identity — skipped
278  * roots never appear in the joined string and are carried separately.
279  * @param {string[]} roots
280  * @returns {Readonly<object>}
281  */
282 export function delimiterRoundTrip(roots = []) {
283   const part = partitionRootsByDelimiter(roots);
284   const resplit = part.joined.length
285     ? part.joined.split(ROOT_DELIM).map((r) => r.trim()).filter(Boolean)
286     : [];
287   const ok =
288     resplit.length === part.transportable.length &&
289     resplit.every((r, i) => r === part.transportable[i]);
290   return Object.freeze({
291     ok,
292     transportable: part.transportable,
293     skipped: part.skipped,
294     joined: part.joined,
295     resplit: Object.freeze(resplit),
296     // Skipped roots are NOT in the joined transport — they ride as unknown rows.
297     skipped_absent_from_join: part.skipped.every((s) => !part.joined.includes(s)
298       || s.includes(ROOT_DELIM)),
299   });
300 }

302 // ── Field binding (criterion 13 + attention) ───────────────────────────────

304 /**
305  * Bind one criterion-13 / attention field from index data.
306  * ANSWERED from index or named per-field `unknown` — never quietly omitted.
307  *
308  * @param {string} field
309  * @param {{
310  *   project_id?: string,
311  *   fresh?: object|null,
312  *   attention?: object|null,
313  *   derived_rows?: object[],
314  *   unreadable?: boolean,
315  *   skipped?: boolean,
316  * }} ctx
317  * @returns {Readonly<{ field: string, value: unknown, known: boolean, source: string|null, mark: string }>}
318  */
319 export function bindGlanceField(field, ctx = {}) {
320   if (ctx.unreadable === true || ctx.skipped === true) {
321     return Object.freeze({
322       field,
323       value: 'unknown',
324       known: false,
325       source: null,
326       mark: 'unknown',
327     });
328   }
329 
330   if (field === 'last_movement') {
331     const last = ctx.fresh?.last_seen ?? null;
332     if (last) {
333       return Object.freeze({
334         field,
335         value: last,
336         known: true,
337         source: 'freshness.per_project[project_id].last_seen',
338         mark: 'ANSWERED',
339       });
340     }
341     return Object.freeze({
342       field,
343       value: 'unknown',
344       known: false,
345       source: 'freshness.per_project[project_id].last_seen',
346       mark: 'unknown',
347     });
348   }
349 
350   if (field === 'stage') {
351     // Prefer attention reason / active effort projection; else named unknown.
352     const att = ctx.attention;
353     if (att?.state && ATTENTION_STATES.includes(att.state)) {
354       // stage is not a first-class attention field — try derived roadmap proj.
355       const rows = Array.isArray(ctx.derived_rows) ? ctx.derived_rows : [];
356       for (const r of rows) {
357         const proj = r?.proj;
358         if (proj && typeof proj === 'object') {
359           const stage =
360             proj.stage ?? proj.phase ?? proj.active_stage ?? proj.current_stage;
361           if (stage != null && String(stage).length > 0) {
362             return Object.freeze({
363               field,
364               value: stage,
365               known: true,
366               source: 'body DERIVED proj.stage',
367               mark: 'ANSWERED',
368             });
369           }
370         }
371       }
372     }
373     // Honest unknown when index has no stage cell (A5 ABSENT path).
374     return Object.freeze({
375       field,
376       value: 'unknown',
377       known: false,
378       source: null,
379       mark: 'unknown',
380     });
381   }
382 
383   if (field === 'runs.live' || field === 'runs.waiting' || field === 'runs.blocked') {
384     const att = ctx.attention;
385     if (att && typeof att === 'object') {
386       // Map attention state onto run buckets when no first-class run cells exist.
387       if (field === 'runs.live' && att.state === 'working') {
388         return Object.freeze({
389           field,
390           value: 1,
391           known: true,
392           source: 'attention.state=working',
393           mark: 'ANSWERED',
394         });
395       }
396       if (field === 'runs.waiting' && (att.state === 'needs_you' || att.state === 'deliverable_ready')) {
397         return Object.freeze({
398           field,
399           value: Math.max(1, Number(att.waiting_steps) || 1),
400           known: true,
401           source: 'attention.state needs_you|deliverable_ready',
402           mark: 'ANSWERED',
403         });
404       }
405       if (field === 'runs.blocked' && att.state === 'blocked') {
406         return Object.freeze({
407           field,
408           value: 1,
409           known: true,
410           source: 'attention.state=blocked',
411           mark: 'ANSWERED',
412         });
413       }
414       if (att.state && ATTENTION_STATES.includes(att.state)) {
415         // Known zero for this bucket.
416         return Object.freeze({
417           field,
418           value: 0,
419           known: true,
420           source: 'attention.state',
421           mark: 'ANSWERED',
422         });
423       }
424     }
425     return Object.freeze({
426       field,
427       value: 'unknown',
428       known: false,
429       source: null,
430       mark: 'unknown',
431     });
432   }
433 
434   if (field === 'attention') {
435     const att = ctx.attention;
436     if (att?.state && ATTENTION_STATES.includes(att.state)) {
437       return Object.freeze({
438         field,
439         value: att.state,
440         known: true,
441         source: 'attention index cell',
442         mark: 'ANSWERED',
443       });
444     }
445     return Object.freeze({
446       field,
447       value: ATTENTION_READ_UNKNOWN,
448       known: false,
449       source: 'attention index cell',
450       mark: 'unknown',
451       failure_code: GLANCE_CODE.ATTENTION_UNKNOWN,
452     });
453   }
454 
455   return Object.freeze({
456     field,
457     value: 'unknown',
458     known: false,
459     source: null,
460     mark: 'unknown',
461   });
462 }

464 /**
465  * Build one glance row with EVERY criterion-13 field present.
466  * @param {object} opts
467  * @returns {Readonly<object>}
468  */
469 export function buildGlanceRow(opts = {}) {
470   const project_id = opts.project_id ?? null;
471   const project_path = opts.project_path ?? opts.root ?? null;
472   const label = opts.label ?? project_id ?? project_path ?? 'unknown';
473   const skipped = opts.skipped === true;
474   const unreadable = opts.unreadable === true;
475 
476   const fields = {};
477   const field_list = [];
478   for (const key of GLANCE_FIELD_KEYS) {
479     const bound = bindGlanceField(key, {
480       project_id,
481       fresh: opts.fresh ?? null,
482       attention: opts.attention ?? null,
483       derived_rows: opts.derived_rows ?? [],
484       unreadable,
485       skipped,
486     });
487     fields[key] = bound;
488     field_list.push(bound);
489   }
490 
491   let status_code = null;
492   let user_text = null;
493   if (skipped) {
494     status_code = GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_ROOT_SKIPPED;
495     user_text = GLANCE_TEXT[status_code].replace('<project>', String(label));
496   } else if (unreadable) {
497     status_code = GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_PROJECT_UNKNOWN;
498     user_text = GLANCE_TEXT[status_code].replace('<project>', String(label));
499   } else if (fields.attention?.known === false) {
500     status_code = GLANCE_CODE.ATTENTION_UNKNOWN;
501     user_text = GLANCE_TEXT[status_code].replace('<project>', String(label));
502   }
503 
504   // Flatten convenience accessors for the fold / raise queue.
505   const attentionState =
506     fields.attention?.known === true
507       ? fields.attention.value
508       : ATTENTION_READ_UNKNOWN;
509 
510   return Object.freeze({
511     schema: GLANCE_ROW_SCHEMA,
512     project_id,
513     project_path,
514     label,
515     skipped,
516     unreadable,
517     unknown: skipped || unreadable || fields.attention?.known === false,
518     status_code,
519     user_text,
520     fields: Object.freeze(fields),
521     field_list: Object.freeze(field_list),
522     // Every GLANCE_FIELD_KEYS key is present — never quietly omitted.
523     field_coverage_complete:
524       field_list.length === GLANCE_FIELD_KEYS.length &&
525       GLANCE_FIELD_KEYS.every((k) => fields[k] != null),
526     attention: attentionState,
527     // The cell's own words, carried whole to the fold: the raise shows the
528     // QUESTION the run stopped on, not a state slug (see foldRowToRaiseItem).
529     attention_reason: opts.attention?.reason ?? null,
530     attention_briefing: opts.attention?.briefing ?? null,
531     stage: fields.stage?.value,
532     runs: Object.freeze({
533       live: fields['runs.live']?.value,
534       waiting: fields['runs.waiting']?.value,
535       blocked: fields['runs.blocked']?.value,
536     }),
537     last_movement: fields.last_movement?.value,
538   });
539 }

541 // ── Fold projections → raise-queue items ───────────────────────────────────
542 
543 /**
544  * Map a glance row / attention cell into a raise-queue item shape.
545  * @param {object} row buildGlanceRow result or synthetic
546  * @returns {object}
547  */
548 export function foldRowToRaiseItem(row = {}) {
549   const attention =
550     row.attention ??
551     row.fields?.attention?.value ??
552     ATTENTION_READ_UNKNOWN;
553   const needsYou =
554     attention === 'needs_you' || attention === 'deliverable_ready';
555   const blocked = attention === 'blocked';
556   const working = attention === 'working';
557 
558   let human_wait = 'none';
559   if (needsYou) {
560     human_wait =
561       row.fields?.attention?.source === 'attention index cell' &&
562       row.attention_reason
563         ? row.attention_reason
564         : attention === 'deliverable_ready'
565           ? 'deliverable_ready'
566           : 'needs_you';
567   } else if (blocked) {
568     human_wait = 'blocked';
569   }
570 
571   const waiting_steps =
572     typeof row.runs?.waiting === 'number'
573       ? row.runs.waiting
574       : needsYou
575         ? 1
576         : 0;
577 
578   // THE BRIEFING (2026-08-06). When the cell carries a commissioned-run
579   // briefing, the raise item answers John's questions before he asks them:
580   // human_wait becomes the QUESTION the run stopped on, last_done what it did,
581   // next_recommended what it would do next. buildRaiseBlock already renders
582   // exactly these fields — nothing there changes.
583   const briefing =
584     row.attention_briefing && typeof row.attention_briefing === 'object'
585       ? row.attention_briefing
586       : null;
587 
588   return {
589     project_id: row.project_id ?? null,
590     project_path: row.project_path ?? null,
591     active_effort:
592       working && row.stage != null && row.stage !== 'unknown'
593         ? String(row.stage)
594         : null,
595     goal_phrase: null,
596     human_wait:
597       needsYou && briefing?.question ? String(briefing.question) : human_wait,
598     last_done: briefing?.did ? String(briefing.did) : undefined,
599     next_recommended: briefing?.next ? String(briefing.next) : undefined,
600     session_id: briefing?.session_id ?? null,
601     capacity: row.unknown ? 'unknown' : 'known',
602     anti_starvation_age_days: 0,
603     packet_ready: attention === 'deliverable_ready',
604     waiting_steps,
605     attention,
606     glance_row: row,
607     // Raise-tier helpers
608     capacity_conflict: false,
609   };
610 }

612 /**
613  * Fold N glance rows into raise-queue items + badge.
614  * @param {object[]} rows
615  * @param {{ starve_threshold_days?: number }} [opts]
616  * @returns {Readonly<object>}
617  */
618 export function foldProjections(rows = [], opts = {}) {
619   const items = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).map(foldRowToRaiseItem);
620   const raiseQueue = buildRaiseQueue(items, opts);
621   return Object.freeze({

623     raise_queue: raiseQueue,
624     badge: raiseQueue.badge,
625     queue_length: raiseQueue.queue_length,
626     row_count: items.length,
627   });
628 }

632 /**
633  * Read badge cache under the index-only trap.
634  * @param {{ home: string, fsx?: object, journal?: object }} req
635  */
636 export function readBadgeCache(req = {}) {
637   const home = req.home;
638   if (!home) {
639     return Object.freeze({
640       ok: false,
641       exists: false,
642       cell: null,
643       reason: 'home_required',
644     });
645   }
646   const journal = req.journal ?? newReadJournal();
647   if (!journal.writes) journal.writes = [];
648   const fsx = req.fsx
649     ? req.fsx
650     : glanceIndexOnlyFs(fs, home, journal);
651   const cellPath = badgeCachePath(home);
652   try {
653     if (typeof fsx.existsSync === 'function' && !fsx.existsSync(cellPath)) {
654       journal.total += 1;
655       journal.reads.push(Object.freeze({ call: 'existsSync', path: cellPath }));
656       return Object.freeze({
657         ok: true,
658         exists: false,
659         cell: null,
660         path: cellPath,
661         journal,
662       });
663     }
664     journal.total += 1;
665     journal.reads.push(Object.freeze({ call: 'existsSync', path: cellPath }));
666     const raw = fsx.readFileSync(cellPath, 'utf8');
667     const cell = JSON.parse(raw);
668     if (!cell || cell.schema !== BADGE_CACHE_SCHEMA) {
669       return Object.freeze({
670         ok: false,
671         exists: true,
672         cell: null,
673         path: cellPath,
674         reason: 'schema_mismatch',
675         code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE,
676         journal,
677       });
678     }
679     return Object.freeze({
680       ok: true,
681       exists: true,
682       cell,
683       path: cellPath,
684       journal,
685       files_opened: journal.total,
686     });
687   } catch (e) {
688     if (e instanceof QueryRefusal || e instanceof WriteAuthorityRefusal) throw e;
689     return Object.freeze({
690       ok: false,
691       exists: false,
692       cell: null,
693       path: cellPath,
694       reason: String(e?.message ?? e),
695       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE,
696       journal,
697     });
698   }
699 }
700 
701 /**
702  * List attention cells under the index home (no project-root walk).
703  * @param {{ home: string, fsx?: object, journal?: object }} req
704  * @returns {ReadonlyArray<object>}
705  */
706 export function listAttentionCellsFromIndex(req = {}) {
707   const home = req.home;
708   if (!home) return Object.freeze([]);
709   const journal = req.journal ?? newReadJournal();
710   if (!journal.writes) journal.writes = [];
711   const fsx = req.fsx ?? glanceIndexOnlyFs(fs, home, journal);
712   const cells = listAttentionCells({ home, fsx });
713   // Journal the readdir-equivalent volume for the files-opened bound.
714   journal.total += 1 + cells.length;
715   journal.reads.push(
716     Object.freeze({ call: 'readdirSync+readFileSync', path: path.join(home, 'attention') }),
717   );
718   return Object.freeze(cells);
719 }
720 
721 /**
722  * Recompute badge from attention cells and write the cache (ingest path).
723  * @param {{ home: string, env?: object, paths?: object }} req
724  */
725 export function recomputeBadgeCache(req = {}) {
726   let home = req.home;
727   if (!home) {
728     try {
729       home = indexPathsFrom({ home: req.home, env: req.env, paths: req.paths }).home;
730     } catch {
731       return Object.freeze({ ok: false, reason: 'home_unresolved' });
732     }
733   }
734   const journal = newReadJournal();
735   journal.writes = [];
736   const readFs = indexOnlyFs(fs, home, journal);
737   const cells = listAttentionCellsFromIndex({ home, fsx: readFs, journal });
738   const raiseItems = cells.map((c) =>
739     foldRowToRaiseItem({
740       project_id: c.project_id,
741       project_path: c.project_path,
742       attention: c.state,
743       attention_reason: c.reason,
744       runs: {
745         waiting:
746           c.state === 'needs_you' || c.state === 'deliverable_ready'
747             ? Math.max(1, Number(c.waiting_steps) || 1)
748             : 0,
749       },
750       fields: {
751         attention: {
752           value: c.state,
753           known: ATTENTION_STATES.includes(c.state),
754           source: 'attention index cell',
755         },
756       },
757     }),
758   );
759   const rq = buildRaiseQueue(raiseItems);
760   const written = writeBadgeCache({
761     home,
762     count: rq.queue_length,
763     queue_length: rq.queue_length,
764     projects: rq.queue.map((q) => q.project_id).filter(Boolean),
765     updated_via: 'recomputeBadgeCache',
766   });
767   return Object.freeze({
768     ok: written.ok === true,
769     count: rq.queue_length,
770     badge: rq.badge,
771     cache: written,
772     cells_read: cells.length,
773     files_opened: journal.total,
774     journal,
775     // Also available via the leaf recompute helper used by attention push.
776     leaf: recomputeBadgeCacheFromHome({ home }),
777   });
778 }

780 /**
781  * Build badge payload from index only — discoverStrips is never reached.
782  * Prefers the cached cell; recomputes under trap if missing.
783  *
784  * @param {{
785  *   home?: string,
786  *   env?: object,
787  *   paths?: object,
788  *   inject?: object,
789  *   roots?: string[],
790  * }} opts
791  * @returns {Readonly<object>}
792  */
793 export function buildBadgeFromIndex(opts = {}) {
794   const inject = opts.inject ?? {};
795 
796   // Test inject: items short-circuit without index (still no discoverStrips).
797   if (Array.isArray(inject.items)) {
798     const rq = buildRaiseQueue(inject.items, inject);
799     return Object.freeze({
800       ok: true,
801       mode: 'badge',
802       badge: rq.badge,
803       queue_length: rq.queue_length,
804       source: 'inject.items',
805       discoverStrips_reached: false,
806       walk_path_unreachable: true,
807       files_opened: 0,
808       files_opened_bound: BADGE_FILES_OPENED_BOUND_CACHED,
809       files_opened_within_bound: true,
810       process_spawns_per_interval: 1,
811     });
812   }
813 
814   let home = opts.home ?? inject.home ?? null;
815   let paths = opts.paths ?? inject.paths ?? null;
816   try {
817     if (!home) {
818       paths = paths ?? indexPathsFrom({ home: opts.home, env: opts.env ?? inject.env, paths });
819       home = paths.home;
820     }
821   } catch (e) {
822     return Object.freeze({
823       ok: false,
824       mode: 'badge',
825       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
826       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
827       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING],
828       badge: { glyph: '⚑', count: null },
829       queue_length: null,
830       discoverStrips_reached: false,
831       walk_path_unreachable: true,
832       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
833     });
834   }
835 
836   if (!home || typeof home !== 'string') {
837     return Object.freeze({
838       ok: false,
839       mode: 'badge',
840       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
841       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
842       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING],
843       badge: { glyph: '⚑', count: null },
844       queue_length: null,
845       discoverStrips_reached: false,
846       walk_path_unreachable: true,
847     });
848   }
849 
850   // Existence of index home (directory) — missing → named failure.
851   if (!fs.existsSync(home)) {
852     return Object.freeze({
853       ok: false,
854       mode: 'badge',
855       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
856       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
857       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING],
858       badge: { glyph: '⚑', count: null },
859       queue_length: null,
860       discoverStrips_reached: false,
861       walk_path_unreachable: true,
862     });
863   }
864 
865   const journal = newReadJournal();
866   journal.writes = [];
867   const guarded = glanceIndexOnlyFs(fs, home, journal);
868 
869   // Prefer cache
870   const cached = readBadgeCache({ home, fsx: guarded, journal });
871   if (cached.ok && cached.exists && cached.cell) {
872     const count = Number(cached.cell.count ?? cached.cell.queue_length ?? 0) || 0;
873     const within = journal.total <= BADGE_FILES_OPENED_BOUND_CACHED;
874     return Object.freeze({
875       ok: true,
876       mode: 'badge',
877       badge: Object.freeze({
878         glyph: cached.cell.glyph ?? '⚑',
879         count,
880         only_ambient_signal: true,
881         law: '⚑ count equals raise queue length; no other ambient notification surfaces anywhere in Anchor',
882       }),
883       queue_length: count,
884       source: 'badge-cache',
885       discoverStrips_reached: false,
886       walk_path_unreachable: true,
887       files_opened: journal.total,
888       files_opened_bound: BADGE_FILES_OPENED_BOUND_CACHED,
889       files_opened_within_bound: within,
890       process_spawns_per_interval: 1,
891       no_walk: Object.freeze({
892         roots_opened: journal.outside.length,
893         index_home_only: journal.outside.length === 0,
894         total_reads: journal.total,
895       }),
896       write_authority: 'none',
897       writes_attempted: journal.writes.length,
898     });
899   }
900 
901   // Cache miss: recompute from attention cells under trap (read), write cache with real fs.
902   try {
903     const cells = listAttentionCellsFromIndex({ home, fsx: guarded, journal });
904     const raiseItems = cells.map((c) =>
905       foldRowToRaiseItem({
906         project_id: c.project_id,
907         project_path: c.project_path,
908         attention: c.state,
909         attention_reason: c.reason,
910         runs: {
911           waiting:
912             c.state === 'needs_you' || c.state === 'deliverable_ready'
913               ? Math.max(1, Number(c.waiting_steps) || 1)
914               : 0,
915         },
916         fields: {
917           attention: {
918             value: c.state,
919             known: ATTENTION_STATES.includes(c.state),
920             source: 'attention index cell',
921           },
922         },
923       }),
924     );
925     const rq = buildRaiseQueue(raiseItems);
926     // Update cache for next poll (ingest-style write on index home — not a project tree).
927     writeBadgeCache({
928       home,
929       count: rq.queue_length,
930       projects: rq.queue.map((q) => q.project_id).filter(Boolean),
931       updated_via: 'buildBadgeFromIndex-cache-miss',
932       fsx: fs,
933     });
934     const within = journal.total <= BADGE_FILES_OPENED_BOUND_RECOMPUTE;
935     return Object.freeze({
936       ok: true,
937       mode: 'badge',
938       badge: rq.badge,
939       queue_length: rq.queue_length,
940       source: 'attention-cells',
941       discoverStrips_reached: false,
942       walk_path_unreachable: true,
943       files_opened: journal.total,
944       files_opened_bound: BADGE_FILES_OPENED_BOUND_RECOMPUTE,
945       files_opened_within_bound: within,
946       process_spawns_per_interval: 1,
947       no_walk: Object.freeze({
948         roots_opened: journal.outside.length,
949         index_home_only: journal.outside.length === 0,
950         total_reads: journal.total,
951       }),
952       write_authority: 'none',
953       writes_attempted: journal.writes.length,
954     });
955   } catch (e) {
956     if (e instanceof QueryRefusal) {
957       return Object.freeze({
958         ok: false,
959         mode: 'badge',
960         error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_QUERY_REFUSED,
961         code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_QUERY_REFUSED,
962         message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_QUERY_REFUSED],
963         detail: e.message,
964         discoverStrips_reached: false,
965         walk_path_unreachable: true,
966         files_opened: journal.total,
967       });
968     }
969     return Object.freeze({
970       ok: false,
971       mode: 'badge',
972       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE,
973       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE,
974       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE],
975       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
976       discoverStrips_reached: false,
977       walk_path_unreachable: true,
978     });
979   }
980 }

982 // ── Portfolio glance assembly ──────────────────────────────────────────────
983 
984 /**
985  * Assemble portfolio-at-a-glance from the index (no root walk).
986  *
987  * @param {{
988  *   home?: string,
989  *   env?: object,
990  *   paths?: object,
991  *   skipped_roots?: string[],
992  *   unreadable_projects?: Array<{project_id?:string, project_path?:string, label?:string}>,
993  *   inject?: object,
994  *   fsx?: object,
995  * }} opts
996  * @returns {Readonly<object>}
997  */
998 export function assemblePortfolioGlance(opts = {}) {
999   const inject = opts.inject ?? {};
1000   const degraded = [];
1001 
1002   // Injected rows (tests / pure fold)
1003   if (Array.isArray(inject.rows)) {
1004     const rows = [...inject.rows];
1005     for (const s of opts.skipped_roots ?? inject.skipped_roots ?? []) {
1006       const pathStr = typeof s === 'string' ? s : s?.project_path ?? s?.root ?? '';
1007       if (!pathStr) continue;
1008       rows.push(
1009         buildGlanceRow({
1010           project_id: typeof s === 'object' ? s.project_id ?? null : null,
1011           project_path: pathStr,
1012           label: typeof s === 'object' ? s.label ?? pathStr : pathStr,
1013           skipped: true,
1014         }),
1015       );
1016     }
1017     for (const u of opts.unreadable_projects ?? inject.unreadable_projects ?? []) {
1018       const already = rows.some(
1019         (r) =>
1020           (u.project_id && r.project_id === u.project_id) ||
1021           (u.project_path && r.project_path === u.project_path),
1022       );
1023       if (already) continue;
1024       rows.push(
1025         buildGlanceRow({
1026           project_id: u.project_id ?? null,
1027           project_path: u.project_path ?? null,
1028           label: u.label ?? u.project_id ?? u.project_path,
1029           unreadable: true,
1030         }),
1031       );
1032     }
1033     if (rows.length > PORTFOLIO_MAX_ROWS) {
1034       return boundExceededResult(rows.length);
1035     }
1036     const folded = foldProjections(rows, inject);
1037     for (const row of rows) {
1038       for (const f of CRITERION_13_FIELDS) {
1039         if (row.fields?.[f]?.known === false) {
1040           degraded.push(
1041             Object.freeze({
1042               project_id: row.project_id,
1043               field: f,
1044               mark: COMPOSITE.DEGRADED,
1045               note: 'A5 field beyond cap / absent in index — named unknown; Wave 19 kill gate cannot green criterion 13 on DEGRADED without signed decision',
1046             }),
1047           );
1048         }
1049       }
1050     }
1051     return Object.freeze({
1052       ok: true,
1053       schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1054       rows: Object.freeze(rows),
1055       row_count: rows.length,
1056       ...folded,
1057       write_authority: 'none',
1058       discoverStrips_reached: false,
1059       degraded: Object.freeze(degraded),
1060       ambient: ambientSignals(folded.badge),
1061       field_coverage: Object.freeze({
1062         keys: GLANCE_FIELD_KEYS,
1063         every_row_complete: rows.every((r) => r.field_coverage_complete === true),
1064       }),
1065     });
1066   }
1067 
1068   let home = opts.home ?? inject.home ?? null;
1069   let paths;
1070   try {
1071     paths = opts.paths ?? inject.paths ?? indexPathsFrom({
1072       home: opts.home,
1073       env: opts.env ?? inject.env,
1074       paths: opts.paths,
1075     });
1076     home = paths.home;
1077   } catch (e) {
1078     return Object.freeze({
1079       ok: false,
1080       schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1081       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
1082       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
1083       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING],
1084       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
1085       rows: Object.freeze([]),
1086       row_count: 0,
1087       discoverStrips_reached: false,
1088       write_authority: 'none',
1089     });
1090   }
1091 
1092   if (!home || !fs.existsSync(home)) {
1093     return Object.freeze({
1094       ok: false,
1095       schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1096       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
1097       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING,
1098       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING],
1099       rows: Object.freeze([]),
1100       row_count: 0,
1101       discoverStrips_reached: false,
1102       write_authority: 'none',
1103     });
1104   }
1105 
1106   const journal = newReadJournal();
1107   journal.writes = [];
1108   const guarded = glanceIndexOnlyFs(opts.fsx ?? fs, home, journal);
1109 
1110   let read;
1111   try {
1112     read = openIndexForRead({ ...opts, paths, home, fsx: guarded, env: opts.env ?? inject.env });
1113   } catch (e) {
1114     if (e instanceof QueryRefusal) {
1115       return Object.freeze({
1116         ok: false,
1117         schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1118         error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_QUERY_REFUSED,
1119         code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_QUERY_REFUSED,
1120         message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_QUERY_REFUSED],
1121         detail: e.message,
1122         rows: Object.freeze([]),
1123         row_count: 0,
1124         discoverStrips_reached: false,
1125         no_walk: noWalkReceipt(journal),
1126         write_authority: 'none',
1127       });
1128     }
1129     return Object.freeze({
1130       ok: false,
1131       schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1132       error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE,
1133       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE,
1134       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE],
1135       detail: String(e?.message ?? e),
1136       rows: Object.freeze([]),
1137       row_count: 0,
1138       discoverStrips_reached: false,
1139       no_walk: noWalkReceipt(journal),
1140       write_authority: 'none',
1141     });
1142   }
1143 
1144   if (read.ok !== true) {
1145     // Distinguish missing vs unparseable
1146     const code =
1147       read.code === 'INDEX_ABSENT' || read.reason === 'absent'
1148         ? GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING
1149         : GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE;
1150     return Object.freeze({
1151       ok: false,
1152       schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1153       error: code,
1154       code,
1155       message: GLANCE_TEXT[code],
1156       detail: read.reason ?? read.text ?? null,
1157       rows: Object.freeze([]),
1158       row_count: 0,
1159       discoverStrips_reached: false,
1160       no_walk: noWalkReceipt(journal),
1161       write_authority: 'none',
1162     });
1163   }
1164 
1165   const events = replayEvents(read.events ?? []);
1166   const registry = materializeRegistry(events);
1167   const snapshot = read.snapshot_value && typeof read.snapshot_value === 'object'
1168     ? read.snapshot_value
1169     : null;
1170   const freshness = snapshot?.freshness && typeof snapshot.freshness === 'object'
1171     ? snapshot.freshness
1172     : { per_project: {} };
1173   const perProject = freshness.per_project && typeof freshness.per_project === 'object'
1174     ? freshness.per_project
1175     : {};
1176 
1177   // Body rows by project for stage binding
1178   const bodyRows = [];
1179   if (snapshot?.body && typeof snapshot.body === 'object') {
1180     const projects = snapshot.body.projects ?? snapshot.body;
1181     // body shape varies — collect derived-like arrays if present
1182     if (Array.isArray(snapshot.body.rows)) bodyRows.push(...snapshot.body.rows);
1183   }
1184 
1185   const attentionCells = listAttentionCellsFromIndex({ home, fsx: guarded, journal });
1186   const attentionById = new Map();
1187   const attentionByPath = new Map();
1188   for (const c of attentionCells) {
1189     if (c.project_id) attentionById.set(String(c.project_id), c);
1190     if (c.key) attentionById.set(String(c.key), c);
1191     // Option-P path passport: a cell pushed by the HOST carries the host's
1192     // project id (Anchor's), which is not the steward registry's id — found
1193     // live 2026-08-06: a real needs_you cell folded to queue 0. The resolved
1194     // project path is the identity both sides share. NEWEST WINS when several
1195     // ids pushed cells for one path (1 folder : N host projects is legal) —
1196     // otherwise a stale cell can shadow a live raise.
1197     if (c.project_path) {
1198       const key = path.resolve(String(c.project_path));
1199       const prev = attentionByPath.get(key);
1200       if (!prev || String(c.at ?? '') >= String(prev.at ?? '')) {
1201         attentionByPath.set(key, c);
1202       }
1203     }
1204   }
1205 
1206   const rows = [];
1207   const projects = Array.isArray(registry.projects) ? registry.projects : [];
1208 
1209   for (const p of projects) {
1210     const pid = p.project_id;
1211     const fresh = perProject[pid] ?? null;
1212     const rowPath = p.current_path ?? p.root ?? null;
1213     const att =
1214       attentionById.get(String(pid)) ??
1215       (rowPath ? attentionByPath.get(path.resolve(String(rowPath))) : null) ??
1216       null;
1217     // Presence UNREACHABLE / unreadable store → unknown row kept.
1218     //
1219     // EXCEPT (2026-08-06, found live): UNREACHABLE means "nobody has checked
1220     // the filesystem yet", not "the root is gone" — and a LIVE attention cell
1221     // pushed by the project moments ago is itself evidence. Zeroing the row
1222     // threw away a real needs_you: the ⚑ badge (which reads cells directly)
1223     // said 1 while the raise queue said 0 — the two surfaces disagreeing about
1224     // the same fact. ABSENT (checked and gone) still marks the row unreadable.
1225     const presence = fresh?.presence ?? p.presence ?? null;
1226     const unreadable =
1227       (presence === PRESENCE.UNREACHABLE && att == null) ||
1228       presence === PRESENCE.ABSENT ||
1229       presence === 'unreadable' ||
1230       p.unreadable === true;
1231 
1232     const derivedForProject = bodyRows.filter(
1233       (r) => r && String(r.project_id) === String(pid),
1234     );
1235 
1236     const row = buildGlanceRow({
1237       project_id: pid,
1238       project_path: p.current_path ?? p.root ?? null,
1239       label: p.label ?? pid,
1240       fresh,
1241       attention: att
1242         ? {
1243             state: att.state,
1244             reason: att.reason,
1245             waiting_steps: att.waiting_steps,
1246             briefing: att.briefing ?? null,
1247           }
1248         : null,
1249       derived_rows: derivedForProject,
1250       unreadable,
1251     });
1252 
1253     // DEGRADED: any A5 field still unknown ships named + gate-report entry
1254     for (const f of CRITERION_13_FIELDS) {
1255       if (row.fields[f]?.known === false) {
1256         degraded.push(
1257           Object.freeze({
1258             project_id: pid,
1259             field: f,
1260             mark: COMPOSITE.DEGRADED,
1261             note: 'A5 field beyond cap / absent in index — named unknown; Wave 19 kill gate cannot green criterion 13 on DEGRADED without signed decision',
1262           }),
1263         );
1264       }
1265     }
1266     rows.push(row);
1267   }
1268 
1269   // Unreadable projects supplied explicitly (not in registry)
1270   for (const u of opts.unreadable_projects ?? inject.unreadable_projects ?? []) {
1271     const already = rows.some(
1272       (r) =>
1273         (u.project_id && r.project_id === u.project_id) ||
1274         (u.project_path && r.project_path === u.project_path),
1275     );
1276     if (already) continue;
1277     rows.push(
1278       buildGlanceRow({
1279         project_id: u.project_id ?? null,
1280         project_path: u.project_path ?? null,
1281         label: u.label ?? u.project_id ?? u.project_path,
1282         unreadable: true,
1283       }),
1284     );
1285   }
1286 
1287   // Semicolon-skipped roots → unknown rows (row count never shrinks)
1288   const skipped = [
1289     ...(opts.skipped_roots ?? []),
1290     ...(inject.skipped_roots ?? []),
1291   ];
1292   for (const s of skipped) {
1293     const pathStr = typeof s === 'string' ? s : s?.project_path ?? s?.root ?? '';
1294     if (!pathStr) continue;
1295     rows.push(
1296       buildGlanceRow({
1297         project_id: typeof s === 'object' ? s.project_id ?? null : null,
1298         project_path: pathStr,
1299         label: typeof s === 'object' ? s.label ?? pathStr : pathStr,
1300         skipped: true,
1301       }),
1302     );
1303   }
1304 
1305   if (rows.length > PORTFOLIO_MAX_ROWS) {
1306     return boundExceededResult(rows.length, journal);
1307   }
1308 
1309   if (rows.length === 0) {
1310     return Object.freeze({
1311       ok: true,
1312       schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1313       code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_PORTFOLIO_EMPTY,
1314       message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_PORTFOLIO_EMPTY],
1315       rows: Object.freeze([]),
1316       row_count: 0,
1317       items: Object.freeze([]),
1318       badge: Object.freeze({
1319         glyph: '⚑',
1320         count: 0,
1321         only_ambient_signal: true,
1322       }),
1323       queue_length: 0,
1324       empty: true,
1325       discoverStrips_reached: false,
1326       no_walk: noWalkReceipt(journal),
1327       write_authority: 'none',
1328       writes_attempted: journal.writes.length,
1329       degraded: Object.freeze(degraded),
1330       ambient: ambientSignals({ count: 0 }),
1331       files_opened: journal.total,
1332     });
1333   }
1334 
1335   const folded = foldProjections(rows, inject);
1336 
1337   // Refresh badge cache so the next poll is cache-hit cheap
1338   try {
1339     writeBadgeCache({
1340       home,
1341       count: folded.queue_length,
1342       projects: folded.raise_queue.queue
1343         .map((q) => q.project_id)
1344         .filter(Boolean),
1345       updated_via: 'assemblePortfolioGlance',
1346       fsx: fs,
1347     });
1348   } catch {
1349     // Cache refresh failure does not fail the glance read.
1350   }
1351 
1352   return Object.freeze({
1353     ok: true,
1354     schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1355     home,
1356     rows: Object.freeze(rows),
1357     row_count: rows.length,
1358     items: folded.items,
1359     raise_queue: folded.raise_queue,
1360     badge: folded.badge,
1361     queue_length: folded.queue_length,
1362     discoverStrips_reached: false,
1363     walk_path_unreachable: true,
1364     no_walk: noWalkReceipt(journal),
1365     write_authority: 'none',
1366     writes_attempted: journal.writes.length,
1367     degraded: Object.freeze(degraded),
1368     ambient: ambientSignals(folded.badge),
1369     files_opened: journal.total,
1370     field_coverage: Object.freeze({
1371       keys: GLANCE_FIELD_KEYS,
1372       every_row_complete: rows.every((r) => r.field_coverage_complete === true),
1373     }),
1374   });
1375 }
1376 
1377 function boundExceededResult(count, journal) {
1378   return Object.freeze({
1379     ok: false,
1380     schema: GLANCE_SCHEMA,
1381     error: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_BOUND_EXCEEDED,
1382     code: GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_BOUND_EXCEEDED,
1383     message: GLANCE_TEXT[GLANCE_CODE.GLANCE_BOUND_EXCEEDED],
1384     refused: true,
1385     portfolio_bound: PORTFOLIO_MAX_ROWS,
1386     attempted_rows: count,
1387     rows: Object.freeze([]),
1388     row_count: 0,
1389     discoverStrips_reached: false,
1390     no_walk: journal ? noWalkReceipt(journal) : null,
1391     write_authority: 'none',
1392   });
1393 }
1394 
1395 /** @param {object} journal */
1396 function noWalkReceipt(journal) {
1397   return Object.freeze({
1398     roots_opened: journal.outside?.length ?? 0,
1399     refused: Object.freeze([...(journal.outside ?? [])]),
1400     reads: Object.freeze([...(journal.reads ?? [])]),
1401     total_reads: journal.total ?? 0,
1402     index_home_only: (journal.outside?.length ?? 0) === 0,
1403   });
1404 }

1406 /**
1407  * Ambient-signal containment: only the badge count; zero ambient beyond it.
1408  * @param {{ count?: number }|null} badge
1409  */
1410 export function ambientSignals(badge = null) {
1411   const count = Number(badge?.count ?? 0) || 0;
1412   return Object.freeze({
1413     only_signal: 'badge',
1414     badge_count: count,
1415     ambient_beyond_badge: 0,
1416     signals: Object.freeze([{ kind: 'badge', count }]),
1417   });
1418 }

1420 // ── Stdout purity (both bridges) ───────────────────────────────────────────
1421 
1422 /**
1423  * Assert a bridge stdout is exactly one JSON line (nothing else).
1424  * @param {string} stdout
1425  * @param {string} bridgeName
1426  * @returns {Readonly<{ ok: boolean, bridge: string, error?: string, parsed?: object }>}
1427  */
1428 export function assertBridgeStdoutPurity(stdout, bridgeName = 'bridge') {
1429   const raw = String(stdout ?? '');
1430   // Allow a single trailing newline; nothing else.
1431   const trimmed = raw.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
1432   const lines = trimmed.endsWith('\n')
1433     ? trimmed.slice(0, -1).split('\n')
1434     : trimmed.split('\n');
1435   if (lines.length !== 1 || lines[0].trim() === '') {
1436     return Object.freeze({
1437       ok: false,
1438       bridge: bridgeName,
1439       error: 'bridge_bad_json',
1440       message: `${bridgeName}: stdout must be exactly one JSON line; got ${lines.length} line(s)`,
1441       mapped: mapBridgeGarbage('bridge_bad_json'),
1442     });
1443   }
1444   try {
1445     const parsed = JSON.parse(lines[0]);
1446     return Object.freeze({
1447       ok: true,
1448       bridge: bridgeName,
1449       parsed,
1450     });
1451   } catch (e) {
1452     return Object.freeze({
1453       ok: false,
1454       bridge: bridgeName,
1455       error: 'bridge_bad_json',
1456       message: `${bridgeName}: stdout is not JSON — ${e.message}`,
1457       mapped: mapBridgeGarbage('bridge_bad_json'),
1458     });
1459   }
1460 }
1461 
1462 /**
1463  * Hash a project tree (files only) for byte-identity write_authority proof.
1464  * @param {string} root
1465  * @param {object} [fsx]
1466  * @returns {string} sha256 hex
1467  */
1468 export function hashProjectTree(root, fsx = fs) {
1469   const files = [];
1470   function walk(dir) {
1471     let entries;
1472     try {
1473       entries = fsx.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
1474     } catch {
1475       return;
1476     }
1477     for (const ent of entries) {
1478       const abs = path.join(dir, ent.name);
1479       if (ent.isDirectory()) walk(abs);
1480       else if (ent.isFile()) files.push(abs);
1481     }
1482   }
1483   walk(root);
1484   files.sort();
1485   const h = crypto.createHash('sha256');
1486   for (const f of files) {
1487     h.update(path.relative(root, f).split(path.sep).join('/'));
1488     h.update('\0');
1489     // encoding-lint: raw-bytes — tree hash fingerprints on-disk bytes, not decoded text
1490     h.update(fsx.readFileSync(f));
1491     h.update('\0');
1492   }
1493   return h.digest('hex');
1494 }
1495 
1496 /**
1497  * Prove write_authority none: hash trees before/after fold+badge+tile path.
1498  * @param {string[]} projectRoots
1499  * @param {() => void} run
1500  * @returns {Readonly<{ ok: boolean, before: object, after: object, identical: boolean }>}
1501  */
1502 export function assertTreesByteIdentical(projectRoots, run) {
1503   const before = {};
1504   for (const r of projectRoots) before[r] = hashProjectTree(r);
1505   run();
1506   const after = {};
1507   for (const r of projectRoots) after[r] = hashProjectTree(r);
1508   const identical = projectRoots.every((r) => before[r] === after[r]);
1509   return Object.freeze({
1510     ok: identical,
1511     before: Object.freeze(before),
1512     after: Object.freeze(after),
1513     identical,
1514     write_authority: 'none',
1515   });
1516 }
1517 
1518 /**
1519  * Client poll contract — parse MIN_MS / MAX_MS from static/high-seat.js source.
1520  * "One poll" = one healthy visible-tab interval (MIN_MS). Failure backoff may
1521  * reach MAX_MS; hidden tabs skip entirely.
1522  *
1523  * @param {string} sourceText contents of static/high-seat.js
1524  * @returns {Readonly<{ MIN_MS: number, MAX_MS: number, ok: boolean }>}
1525  */
1526 /**
1527  * Parse a millisecond assignment from client JS source.
1528  * Accepts a bare integer (`90000`) or a pure product (`15 * 60 * 1000`) —
1529  * the form static/high-seat.js uses for the MAX_MS ceiling.
1530  *
1531  * @param {string} src
1532  * @param {string} name identifier on the left of `=`
1533  * @returns {number} finite ms, or NaN when the assignment is absent/unparseable
1534  */
1535 function parseClientMsAssignment(src, name) {
1536   const re = new RegExp(
1537     String.raw`\b${name}\s*=\s*([0-9]+(?:\s*\*\s*[0-9]+)*)`,
1538   );
1539   const m = src.match(re);
1540   if (!m) return NaN;
1541   const factors = m[1].split(/\s*\*\s*/).map((p) => Number(p));
1542   if (factors.length === 0 || factors.some((n) => !Number.isFinite(n))) return NaN;
1543   return factors.reduce((acc, n) => acc * n, 1);
1544 }
1545 
1546 export function importClientPollConstants(sourceText) {
1547   const src = String(sourceText ?? '');
1548   // Prefer Wave-17 named constants; fall back to local MIN_MS / MAX_MS aliases.
1549   // Product expressions (15 * 60 * 1000) must evaluate — capturing only the
1550   // leading 15 would silently shrink the backoff ceiling 60_000×.
1551   const MIN_MS = (() => {
1552     const named = parseClientMsAssignment(src, 'ECG_HS_MIN_MS');
1553     if (Number.isFinite(named)) return named;
1554     return parseClientMsAssignment(src, 'MIN_MS');
1555   })();
1556   const MAX_MS = (() => {
1557     const named = parseClientMsAssignment(src, 'ECG_HS_MAX_MS');
1558     if (Number.isFinite(named)) return named;
1559     return parseClientMsAssignment(src, 'MAX_MS');
1560   })();
1561   return Object.freeze({
1562     MIN_MS,
1563     MAX_MS,
1564     ok: Number.isFinite(MIN_MS) && Number.isFinite(MAX_MS) && MIN_MS > 0,
1565     // Contract documentation (not silently violated):
1566     one_poll_definition: 'one healthy visible-tab interval (MIN_MS)',
1567     failure_backoff_may_reach_MAX_MS: true,
1568     hidden_tab_polls_skip: true,
1569   });
1570 }
1571 
1572 /**
1573  * Removal-proof: badge route source must not call discoverStrips / verbStatus.
1574  * @param {string} sourceText high-seat-bridge or glance module source
1575  * @returns {Readonly<{ ok: boolean, discoverStrips_refs: number, verbStatus_on_badge: boolean }>}
1576  */
1577 export function assertBadgePathDoesNotWalk(sourceText) {
1578   const src = String(sourceText ?? '');
1579   // buildBadgeFromIndex body must not invoke discoverStrips
1580   const badgeFn = src.includes('buildBadgeFromIndex') || src.includes('buildBadgePayload');
1581   // Count discoverStrips invocations that are not comments
1582   const lines = src.split('\n').filter((l) => !/^\s*(\/\/|\*)/.test(l));
1583   const body = lines.join('\n');
1584   // For bridge: buildBadgePayload should call buildBadgeFromIndex, not verbStatus
1585   const badgeSection = extractFunctionBody(src, 'buildBadgePayload')
1586     ?? extractFunctionBody(src, 'buildBadgeFromIndex')
1587     ?? '';
1588   const discoverInBadge = /discoverStrips\s*\(/.test(badgeSection);
1589   const verbStatusInBadge = /verbStatus\s*\(/.test(badgeSection);
1590   return Object.freeze({
1591     ok: badgeFn && !discoverInBadge && !verbStatusInBadge,
1592     discoverStrips_reached: discoverInBadge,
1593     verbStatus_on_badge: verbStatusInBadge,
1594     badge_function_present: badgeFn,
1595   });
1596 }
1597 
1598 /** @param {string} src @param {string} name */
1599 function extractFunctionBody(src, name) {
1600   const re = new RegExp(
1601     `(?:export\\s+)?function\\s+${name}\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*\\{`,
1602   );
1603   const m = re.exec(src);
1604   if (!m) return null;
1605   let i = m.index + m[0].length;
1606   let depth = 1;
1607   const start = i;
1608   while (i < src.length && depth > 0) {
1609     if (src[i] === '{') depth += 1;
1610     else if (src[i] === '}') depth -= 1;
1611     i += 1;
1612   }
1613   return src.slice(start, i - 1);
1614 }
